profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Roblox
profile.summary:
Generalist. Former Microsoft MVP awardee (C#). 
Hit on AppStore Top #1 with free app (NATON : iOS instant messaging app, Korea, 2009).
  
Enjoying firefighting towards technical problems, fast learner, with hearty startup spirit. 
Once got O-1 Visa status (i.e. 'An individual with extraordinary ability or achievement').

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Connecting pipes under the hood for Studio development (June 2018 ~ June 2022)
- Modernizing .NET applications; From hosted to containerized with up-to-date devops packages.
- Creating large scale applications supporting Studio users.

Still connecting pipes under the hood for Avatar Marketplace (June 2022~)
- Backend for Search and Recommendation system of Marketplace service.
- Customed telemetry setup with application context to support global wide analysis.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
http://ondemandkorea.com

Had worked on;
- HLS packaging, delivering to CDN storage
- Handling video traffic over 100Gbps in peak
- Developing iOS, tvOS, Android apps
- Video content metadata indexing on document-based NoSQL database
- Converting subtitles between ASS/SRT/VTT, adapting on web / native video players (incl. Korean, Chinese)
- Integrating video advertisement SDK on iOS, Android
- Migrating Wordpress based web site to Django based
- Collecting, processing, analyzing logs from video play for QoS

Keywords:
- Language: Python, Objective-C, Swift, PHP, Java
- Web framework: Django, Flask
- Data storage: RDS (Aurora), S3, Elasticsearch, ElastiCache (Redis)
- Adaptive Streaming: HLS, ffmpeg
- CDN: Akamai, Limelight
- Advertisement platform: Google DoubleClick for Publishers, Google Interactive Media Ads, LiveRail
- Deployment platform: AWS EC2, Fabric, Docker, Vagrant
- BI: Tableau

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
http://perfectprice.io

Price Optimization biz. Providing price testing / suggestion tool. Developing web frontend and its backend: 
- Log aggregation, Dashboard report including realtime graph.
- Deployment and service monitoring
- ETL scripts in Python.
 
Technologies:
Django, Python, jQuery, d3.js, bootstrap, ElasticSearch, MySQL, Rackspace (OpenStack), Fabric

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
http://tunedra.com 

Music entertainment mobile app biz. Development iOS app and its server side API:
- Web layer: Introduction, instant song player (HTML5 audio / SoundManager2), APIs for mobile app (auth, in-app purchase, community features, etc)
- iOS layer: Auth, community features, instant song player, SNS integration (fb, tw, g+), AWS S3 file uploading.
- DevOps: Mainly AWS. Server codes and static resources deployment. CDN, mail configuration. Monitoring configuration.

Technologies:
Django, Python, Objective-C, iOS, Fabric, Boto, AWS (EC2, S3, CloudFront, ELB, SES), MySQL (AWS RDS), iOS in-app purchase.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Employee #1 in Engineering:
- Founding new business, Django-based web site utilizing IVR/SMS API, .NET interop Quickbook plugin.

Technologies:
Django, .NET, Twilio

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
Mobile apps and services development:
- Published apps: BITNA, NATON(#1 in 2009, Korea), Mug, Stopwatch K. 
- Mobile apps on iOS, Android, WP 7.5 and Django-based APIs for Mobile apps.

Technologies:
Django, iOS, Objective-C, Android, Windows Phone 7.5, Tornado, PostgreSQL, PostGIS

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Extensive database application in wide range of Business Intelligence system using C#,
Oracle & PL/SQL.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software development: 
- Embedded mobile software development, C#, WinCE.

positions.title: Freelancer
positions.description: Software development in various system environments and business areas. From Windows system maintenance to web server/client programming, database programming and administrating, mobile application development.
